author: Veara_
body:
Username: MrPieGaming (formerly know as pieface3450) 

Reason I was banned: A moderator thought I was hacking in a match of Control the Hill. This happened at 1:47 PM EST.

Why I should be unbanned?: I should be unbanned because I was never hacking. I don't use hacked clients on servers I care about. I was just pvping in a match of Control the Hill, and on the moderator's screen (javipepe) it could have looked like I was using some kind of pvp hacks. I am being 100% honest when I say I was not hacking, I did not use any such hacked client on Avicus. I can even post pictures  of my Minecraft screen, resource packs, and my versions folder. I truly do believe this ban is false, I have asked myself all of the questions that are listed in the Infraction Appeal topic, and I 100% believe this ban is false.
